import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

runtime = Path("src/do_again/browser/runtime.py")
lines = runtime.read_text().splitlines()

start = None
end = None
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if line.strip() == 'message = (' and i > 0 and 'batch_marker' in lines[i - 1]:
        start = i
        break
if start is None:
    raise SystemExit("batch message block start not found")

for i in range(start, min(start + 20, len(lines))):
    if lines[i].strip() == ')' and i > start:
        end = i + 1
        break
if end is None:
    raise SystemExit("batch message block end not found")

replacement = [
    '    newline = chr(10)',
    '    message = (',
    '        batch_marker',
    '        + ". Inspect these receipts on "',
    '        + str(record.get("control_branch", "operator-control"))',
    '        + " in order, continue the existing goal once across the batch, and use another scoped "',
    '        + "Do Again request only if more local work is needed:"',
    '        + newline',
    '        + newline.join(rows)',
    '    )',
]

lines[start:end] = replacement
runtime.write_text(chr(10).join(lines) + chr(10))

subprocess.run([
    "python3", "-m", "py_compile",
    "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py",
    "src/do_again/service/daemon.py",
], check=True)

subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_browser", "tests.test_daemon"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_*.py"], check=True)

subprocess.run([
    "git", "add",
    "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py",
    "src/do_again/browser/__init__.py",
    "src/do_again/service/daemon.py",
    "tests/test_browser.py",
    "tests/test_daemon.py",
], check=True)

subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", "Batch browser receipt notifications"], check=True)

push = subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"])
if push.returncode != 0:
    subprocess.run(["git", "fetch", "origin", "main"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "rebase", "origin/main"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "py_compile", "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py", "src/do_again/service/daemon.py"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_browser", "tests.test_daemon"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_*.py"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"], check=True)

print("HEAD=" + subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip())
print("STATUS=")
print(subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--short"], text=True))
